originalProcess.reason: The transcript does not record the environment of the Claude Code process that ran the original turn. The current shell's status says nothing certain about it: it is a child shell of the current process, which may or may not be the same process, and it may have had its environment changed.

observations: The original run had a three-level chain of gem-upgrade-planner agents (depth 1 -> 2 -> 3), each spawning the next via the Agent tool. The depth-1 agent's final report, which the main session relayed to the user, said the planner 'did the analysis directly because no subagent tool was available to it'. The transcripts contradict that: depth 1 and depth 2 each called the Agent tool (subagent_type maintain-rails:gem-upgrade-planner), and depth 3 did the experiments. That sentence in the relayed plan is inaccurate. The audit does not revise the plan.
All 4 instances report the same model (claude-sonnet-5-5), the same per-turn effort (medium) and the same CLI version (2.1.296).
limitations: perTurnEffort values come from the perTurnEffort and effort fields on assistant rows. How effort was derived (default, session setting, inherited by subagents, or env var) is not recorded.
